$comment: Shrink-only. Stellr-only admin list reads of tenant-scoped tables that do not yet keep to Stellr's rows (tracker s5-programme.29). test/stellr-only-lists-ratchet.test.ts fails on a new unfiltered site and on a listed site that is now filtered or gone. Keys are '<file> :: <table>'. A new entry needs a reason a person wrote; prefer filtering with stellrRows (lib/tenancy/stellr-scope.ts).

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/academy/train.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). The academy training editor lists every training module and its reminder settings; a module tied to an event carries that event's tenant through event_ref. Filter with stellrRows before a tenant event can own a module.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/activity-log/.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). The activity log lists recent event participations across all events with the member joined. Filter with stellrRows before a tenant event writes participations.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/community/mod.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). Moderation looks up resource titles by the ids of flagged items it has already loaded, not a list of its own. Follows the flagged-items read; filter if that read becomes tenant-aware.

Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). Moderation looks up container names by the ids of flagged items it has already loaded, not a list of its own. Follows the flagged-items read; filter if that read becomes tenant-aware.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/community/spa.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). The community spaces admin lists every unarchived space. B9 skips space sync for another tenant's event, so other tenants' spaces are not expected; filter with stellrRows to make that explicit.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/competitions/.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). Counts participants per competition, keyed by the slugs of Stellr's Sanity competitions it lists. A slug shared with a tenant event would merge counts until S8 makes slugs unique per tenant.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/media/page.ts.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). The media page builds its event picker from every registration's event slug and title. Filter with stellrRows so another tenant's events do not appear in the picker.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/members/volun.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). Volunteer roles per member, keyed by the member ids already on the page (members are identity rows shared across tenants). Filter with stellrRows so a tenant event's volunteer roles are not shown.

Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). Volunteer interest per member, keyed by the member ids already on the page. Filter with stellrRows so interest raised on a tenant event is not counted.

app/(stellr)/(admin)/admin/scholarships/.reason: Unfiltered when this ratchet started (s5-programme.29 follow-up). The scholarships admin lists every application. Filter with stellrRows before a tenant event can take scholarship applications.
